cell_id_distance_bookkeeping: d(a,b)=max(|a|,|b|,|a+b|); used only to define finite cell sets, not geometric length.

PARALLELOGRAM_BLOCK.derivation: Cartesian product of m allowed i-indices and n allowed j-indices

POSITIVE_U_RAY.derivation: one distinct CELL_ID for each integer j=1..r

SHELL.derivation: six A2 side runs, r cells per side with corners counted once

scope_boundary: The formulas count independently declared CELL_ID sets. No equation identifies the primary ray count n with a region count parameterized by the stored staircase magnitude a_n unless an independent bijection/constraint is proved.
